offering.name: Data Integration & Pipelines
offering.tagline: Move data reliably between the systems that need it.
offering.summary: design and delivery of reliable, monitored data pipelines that move and transform data between systems, eliminating manual exports and dual entry
capabilities: Automated extract, transform, and load (ETL/ELT) pipelines
Data lineage and processing audit trail
typical_requirements: Eliminate manual data exports and dual entry
Move data automatically between systems on a schedule or event
Validate and reconcile data in flight
Alert on failures with clear diagnostics
Maintain lineage and an audit trail
differentiators: Reconciliation built in — you know the data arrived intact
Observable pipelines with lineage and clear failure alerts
offering.pricing_model: Fixed price by workstream, invoiced on milestones
success_metrics: manual exports and dual entry eliminated
failures surfaced and resolved via alerting

snippets.understanding: Your teams manually export and re-key data between systems, and errors slip through unnoticed. You need automated, monitored pipelines you can trust.
snippets.solution: We will build automated ETL/ELT pipelines — scheduled or event-driven — that move and transform data between your systems with validation, reconciliation, lineage, and clear failure alerting, so manual exports and dual entry go away.

product_line.name: Data & Analytics
product_line.summary: Data platforms, pipelines, and analytics that turn scattered data into decisions.
